description.value: An unbound world of 1.79 Earth masses, crossing the Cold Margin at forty-one kilometres a second and bound to nothing. A hydrogen-thickened nitrogen atmosphere holds its surface at minus 213 degrees rather than the minus 260 it would otherwise sit at, and radiogenic heat maintains a brine ocean beneath ninety kilometres of ice. Cell-like material was recovered from a surface crevasse in 2262 and remains the most argued-over sample in the sector. It is catalogued against Bobbin because it was found there, not because it belongs to it.
Svet brez zvezde, ki ga greje le notranja toplota; pod ledom je slanično morje.

Um mundo sem estrela, com 1,79 massas terrestres, que atravessa a Cold Margin a quarenta e um quilómetros por segundo sem estar preso a nada. Uma atmosfera de azoto espessada por hidrogénio mantém a sua superfície a menos 213 graus, em vez dos menos 260 em que de outro modo estaria, e o calor radiogénico sustenta um oceano de salmoura sob noventa quilómetros de gelo. Em 2262 recolheu-se material de aspeto celular numa fenda da superfície, e continua a ser a amostra mais discutida do setor. Está catalogado sob Bobbin porque ali foi encontrado, não porque lhe pertença.

atmosphere.value: Nitrogen with six per cent hydrogen at 3.4 bar, still, black and completely clear. A hand lamp carries further here than anywhere else in the register.

notes.value: The register requires a year length. This entry gives zero, which is wrong in a different way from every other number that could have been put there.
